judge_notes.opus5: TTF has roughly doubled since the 28 July guide (i0) on a company that has cut guidance twice this year on exactly that driver, whose European segment earned $6m at a 0.9% margin and whose hedges thin out in 2027, and the stock has rallied 13% into the print; the +9.9 skew and Ardagh's European furnace closures (i2) are why it is not larger.

judge_notes.sonnet55: European gas has nearly doubled since the July guide and two prior cuts each drew about -15%; Ardagh's weak North America read adds, offset by capacity exits and a 13% run-up.
judge_notes.fable51: European gas has doubled since the July guide with 2027 only half hedged and Ardagh showing NA glass shipments -6%, on a name that fell 15% on each of its last two cuts and has rallied 13% into the print; furnace closures and Constellation restocking are the offsets.
